fieldguide.supplementaries.clock_block.d:
ID: T-001
Class: Tool

Known information:
It will only use its power of time travel with a living participant, drawing from their current energy pools to do so. 

If Blood on the Clocktower is used on an empty stomach, it will draw directly from the user's soul energy, causing time related distortions.
fieldguide.supplementaries.clock_block.h: Let the clock get a taste
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.red_phone.descrip:
ID: T-002
Class: Tool

Known information:
The voice behind the phone is colloquially known as 'the tongue of the devil'. Making a request of it seems to whip up random abnormalities in the facility into a frenzy.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.horseshoe.descrip:
ID: T-003
Class: Tool

Known information:
Widely regarded as a safe abnormality, Horsehoe Theory resonates with nearby containment units, allowing the user to see the stats of them remotely.
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.horseshoe.hint: Place in front of a Containment Unit
fieldguide.whimsy_deco.gatcha_machine.de:
ID: T-004
Class: Tool

Known information:
The earliest user of the Gotchya Machine was driven to believe she was a soldier in the british infantry during the 18th century.
It seems to draw in unknowing users with the promise of toys, occasionally causing psychic distortions that disrupt abnormalities.
fieldguide.abyssal_decor.bottomless_bag_:
ID: T-005
Class: Tool

Known information:
Careful usage of NIRVANA is advised, as spilling the bag may result in entombment. When handled carefully, an entirely safe abnormality.
fieldguide.minecraft.enchanting_table.de:
ID: T-006
Class: Tool

Known information:
It is not known of 'Eraserhead' is a being inside the table, or the table itself. Regardless, it seems to have a disdain for greed, chopping off the head of the user if it gives an enchantment that the user already has on the item it offers.
fieldguide.companions.frog_bonanza_block:
ID: T-007
Class: Tool

Known information:
Gambledeath is a roguelike machine of froglike orgins that can be fed coins. It seems to be malevolent, heavily punishing users with 'permadeath' if their luck fails.
fieldguide.scp.rubber_duck.description:
ID: T-009
Class: Tool

Known information:
Promises of endless fortune are fortold by the Rubber Duck.
 The gold it drops seems to be at the expense of living abnormalities.
fieldguide.scp.spoon_bender.description:
ID: T-010
Class: Tool

Known information:
Spoon Benders are incredibly fast, presenting as simple garden gnomes. They seem to love small objects left around, instantly grabbing items no matter where they are located.

 Enjoys messing around with the internals of containment units, occasionally damaging them.
fieldguide.scguns.the_pact.description:
ID: T-011
Class: Tool

Known information:
Not much is known about where the merchant that is summoned form Devil Deeds Done Dirt Cheap, or what happens to the abnormality when it is summoned. No adverse affects have been observed from usage in the last 45 years.
